'''Broadberry Meadow''' was a small island park located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

==History==
Located on a small island at a fork in the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] as it plunged over the cliffs of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Broadberry Meadow was an open park only reachable by boat. Located in the shadow of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]], a dock was erected on the palace-side of the island and serviced small boats that the local [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] used to float about the river. At the center of the island was a small rotunda which shared the traditional sandstone block construct and green-tiled roof as many of the other buildings in the city. Primarily used for event space or important government business by members of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House]] and those who visited the Palace, the surrounding lawns were well-tended lawns and flower gardens. The pathways were lined with bricks, leading from the rotunda to several recreational fields, an orchard, and through dense stands of trees.<ref name="SWCL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Broadberry Meadow was first identified in the sourcebook ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' following the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Like other features of the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the exact location remains conjectural following the release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], as the city seems to have been reversed.
